name: ArmaReforger
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install an Arma Reforger server and run it. **ATTENTION:** First startup can take a long time since it downloads the server files and installs the runtimes! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. Additional server configuration can be modified in default-config.json, located in the server installation directory, but the environment variables will override if they are available to be set.
